title: Austin's Housing Budget Gets Green Light
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) approved its budget for the upcoming fiscal year.
*   This budget covers AHFC operations from October 1, 2020, to September 30, 2021.
*   All budget-related items were quickly passed through a consent agenda.
